# Dabble

> > Dabble is a cloud-based novel writing software designed for authors to organize plots, characters, and worldbuilding in one intuitive platform.

Dabble provides writers with specialized tools like Plot Grid, Character Profiles, and Worldbuilding features to streamline the novel-writing process. The platform offers flexible subscription plans, desktop downloads, and an active community of authors.

## Key Topics
